addDomainDetailCodes.remedy: the Plan-bound provider input (snapshot, dependency sources or prepared outputs) does not fit the provider protocol frame, entry or request limits under the host's canonical send schedule; reduce or split that input - nothing is truncated or re-chunked

a Plan-bound provider input string cannot be carried by the provider protocol unchanged: a dependency source package name or version containing a scalar at or below U+0020, a non-NFC name, version, source id or path, a package key over 4096 scalars, or a dependency source file path, prepared output site path or generated-file logical path with a '.' or '..' segment, a leading '/', or an empty or drive-prefix segment where its path law forbids them; rename or exclude it - nothing is normalized

native.dependency-source-not-wire-repres.applies: phase A, before the owner: a file path of a package the owner would hash that fails the owner path schema (the owner cannot mint its file-manifest identity); phase B, only after the owner admits the set, owner DS refusals keeping precedence: NFC, name/version scalars, key length, canonical-path narrowing. A refused set mints no dependencySourceSetId.

timingAnchor.needle: snapshot seal and dependency-source admission, before PlanId:

native.prepared-output-not-wire-represen.applies: before the owner (its typed admission would raise instead of refusing), in both explicit and defaulted prepared mode

timingAnchor.needle: is refused before Plan construction (`REQUEST.PRECONDITION_FAILED`, detail

native.prepared-output-exceeds-wire-limi.applies: only when the owner outcome is admitted and prepared mode was selected explicitly; when prepared mode was defaulted the over-limit set is ignored with a wireLimitDisclosure and owners are analyzed non-prepared (owner PO-1 mode law, nativeMd 1853-1856); owner non-inert and stale outcomes keep precedence

timingAnchor.needle: is refused before Plan construction (`REQUEST.PRECONDITION_FAILED`, detail

native.provider-request-exceeds-wire-lim.applies: after PlanId and every set admission, before any worker is spawned; the refusal is stated in terms of the canonical host send schedule, not of every lawful encoding
native.provider-request-exceeds-wire-lim.anchorScope: timing only: the anchored step's own existing outcome for a missing capability is Coverage unknown / provider-unavailable; this refusal is a distinct request refusal taken at the same no-spawn point
native.provider-request-exceeds-wire-lim.planIdFate: plan2 has been computed but is not published: the termination carries no runId, coverageId or executionId, no run3 and no Coverage is minted, no worker is spawned, and the plan2 value is retained only in the operational record
